routes.reason: GL2ModularityLifting follows KW II with defect l0 = 0; nothing in the atlas proves R = T for weight-one forms or Bianchi forms, where l0 = 1 and the Hecke modules are balanced, not free. So a Part II is justified. The distinct id beside PAPER-IYENGAR-KHARE-MANNING-24's GL2ModularityLiftingPositiveDefect is right: IKM's is the non-minimal continuation and imports this route, and make_queue.py does not merge two papers' routes with the same id. The review added the deduction of Theorem 1.2 from Theorem 1.3, the cartesian degeneracy squares and two steps of Theorem 3.30(4). An addendum to the brief records E221 (L_σ at level V), E224 (Steinberg quotient at v ≡ −1 mod p Steinberg primes) and E226.

PotentialAutomorphyInfrastructure plans the unconditional CM-field descendant; the conditional GL_n theory over arbitrary F (Conjecture B as hypotheses, Lemma 9.6, the complexes D̃_N, Theorem 9.19) is planned nowhere. The review added 'Serre modular of minimal level' and corrected Lemma 9.6's key step (E229). The brief's addendum records E229, E213 and E214.

notes:
Accept after corrections made in place. The review was done by Claude Code (session cc-38267a) against the published PDF (CG.pdf, SHA-256 c0ba8de0…), arXiv v2 and its TeX source, with ten checkers splitting pp. 297–433; they opened every cited declaration, read every cited layer description and checked every recorded mistake on the page image. The coordinator re-derived the substantive new findings in the TeX. Items: 78 corrected; 16 added and one duplicate removed, giving 510 (8 library, 224 planned, 278 missing). Status changes: fricke-w-x and tw-local-selmer-dimension are missing (their cited layers do not plan them); several planned lists were corrected (prop-2-3-R-presentation, rem-3-10-stacks, assumption-3-9, prop-6-6 and others). Source issues: E1–E217 are all confirmed. Duplicated scope was removed from E2, E14, E21, E24, E81 (re-scoped to the p. 361 slip), E84, E96, E146, E148, E155, E176 and E208, and E26, E147 and E180 had kind or affects changed. E218–E230 are new:
- E221 (error, the proof): the p. 344 claim that flat pullback of L_σ equals the level-V invariant sheaf fails at cusps where both covers ramify (the fibre product O⟦s,r⟧/(s^x − r^e) is not normal).
- E224 (error, the proof): at v ≡ −1 mod p with ρ̄|G_v a ramified twist of (ω̄ ∗; 0 1), R_{v,φ} has components of conductor v² outside the support of S_φ, so the §4.1 R = T isomorphisms fail as printed; the Steinberg quotient repairs them.
- E229 (gap, the proof): Lemma 9.6's intermediate isomorphism at the anaemic m is unproved; localizing at m̃ = (m, U_x − α_x) repairs it.
- The rest are misprints.
No main theorem changes. All 23 routes are accepted; the three Part II briefs gained addenda.
